primaryOpportunityResult.label: opportunity_right_multiple_acceptable_expressions
primaryOpportunityResult.interpretation: The first independent V1.3 holdout supports the opportunity-first objective: both frozen acceptable expressions produced positive 60d benchmark excess, so exact ex-ante peer ranking was unnecessary for capturing the direction.

researchOpportunityDiagnostics.label: research_direction_right_primary_blocked_by_duration_risk
researchOpportunityDiagnostics.interpretation: The direction worked at 60d despite peak-duration concerns. Same-period success may not relax the expectation-path gate; repeat evidence is required.

researchOpportunityDiagnostics.label: research_direction_right_premium_growth_blocked
researchOpportunityDiagnostics.interpretation: The NEV direction was right and the research basket beat the benchmark, but the frozen valuation/duration concerns remain legitimate. Do not promote from this same-period outcome.

researchOpportunityDiagnostics.label: negative_physical_cycle_fail_closed
researchOpportunityDiagnostics.interpretation: No selected ticker was forced against weak DRAM physical evidence.

opportunityFirst.evidence: Primary metals basket captured the opportunity with two independently acceptable expressions; exact peer-best identification was not required.

avoidWrongExpression.evidence: 中国铝业/铜陵有色 remained controls rather than being promoted solely because metals were strong; DRAM remained No selection.

captureMoreOpportunities.evidence: Both Research-level shipping and NEV hypotheses also produced positive 60d benchmark excess.
captureMoreOpportunities.nextQuestion: Does V1.3 repeatedly identify correct Research directions that remain non-actionable because Primary gates are too conservative?

archetypeDiscipline.note: Cyclical shipping and metals were evaluated on normalized earnings-path duration; premium NEV was evaluated on long-duration growth expectations. Durable-cash-yield logic was not needed in this window.

decision.reason: The first independent V1.3 holdout validates the opportunity-first/acceptable-expression structure, but one window is insufficient to loosen Primary gates for Research opportunities.
decision.nextAction: Run unchanged V1.3 on another untouched historical window. Track opportunity-level hit rate, Research-direction recall, and wrong-expression rate separately.

prohibitedUses: Do not promote shipping or NEV to High-priority using this same-period outcome.
Do not remove expectation-path or duration-risk gates because Research selections later worked.
Do not restore exact peer-best ranking as the primary success definition.
Do not use 120d outcomes to rewrite the pre-registered 60d decision.
